No network operations, dynamic downloads, or file modifications occur during packaging beyond what is declared in the source array.

All operations are confined to the package build environment and follow standard AUR conventions. There is no use of `eval`, `curl|bash`, obfuscated code, or execution of external scripts. The package installs only its own binaries and license file, with no evidence of data exfiltration, backdoors, or unauthorized system access. While the binary nature of the payload limits static analysis of the final executable, the packaging itself shows no signs of tampering or malicious intent.
